title: Boundless-energy wall advertisement
slide_intent: Test a campaign at architectural scale because attention and reading order change across a street.
strategic_value: A large image pair and short text block can make Dropbox’s creative proposition visible at a distance.
demonstration: A painted wall advertisement pairs burgundy copy with abstract pink-and-dark imagery and a small signature; pedestrians and road markings supply scale.
practical_value: Compare headline prominence with the image and signature in a street setting.

content_islands.name: Message block
content_islands.spec: Place the short headline on the burgundy left panel.

content_islands.name: Image pair and signature
content_islands.spec: Join the abstract images to its right and retain the signature at the far edge.

content_islands.name: Street scale
content_islands.spec: Keep pedestrians and roadway in view.

reference_purposes.Application: A painted wall advertisement pairs burgundy copy with abstract pink-and-dark imagery and a small signature; pedestrians and road markings supply scale.
